sections.markdown:
## E - Market Signal, Section Seven Laws and Rules of the Road

Market research for this chapter stays scoped to the handbook road-rule facts themselves, and no separate market study was performed for this section. No competitive intelligence artifact was supplied upstream, so no competitor teardown, pricing survey, or demand sizing is asserted here. Candidate demand, pass rates, and study-room behavior are left unmeasured rather than estimated. Any future market pack should start from the road-rule-facts audience of first-time applicants and verify demand against issuer-published candidate counts before quoting figures.
